subject.title: supply-e2e: workflow roto por Node 20 sin WebSocket nativo en el CLI de Device Cloud

question: Should maintainers leave this assigned Supply E2E workflow bug with the current assignee, or explicitly authorize an automated repair to take it over?
rationale: The fix direction is clear, but AGENTS.md coordination says agents should stop before code work when an issue is already assigned to another person unless a human confirms the takeover.

options.title: Leave with assigned owner
options.body: Keep the issue assigned and let the current owner or infrastructure team make the small workflow change.

options.title: Authorize automated repair
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly authorize automation to patch only `.github/workflows/supply-e2e.yml` and validate the workflow path.

recommendation.title: Leave with assigned owner
recommendation.body: Keep the issue assigned and let the current owner or infrastructure team make the small workflow change.
